def joint_native_block(data, cfg: PhiConfig, q: np.ndarray) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Actual 60 Phi + 45 SU4 link static block, including both contacts.

    Link coordinates sit at their source vertex. This is NOT an EM photon
    replacement: generators act on the same four orbital colours as Phi.
    """
    size = data['size']; sites = data['sites']; volume = len(sites)
    theta = 2*np.pi*sites/size
    qtheta = 2*np.pi*np.asarray(q)/size
    target = np.ravel_multi_index(((sites+q)%size).T,(size,)*3)
    frame,basis = data['frame'],data['basis']
    generators = basis/np.sqrt(8)
    orbit = np.asarray([1j*(t@frame-frame@t) for t in generators])
    orbit_columns = np.einsum('tmij,aji->mat',orbit,basis).real.reshape(60,15)/4
    gauge = np.zeros((105,15),complex)
    gauge[:60] = orbit_columns
    align_vertex = np.zeros((180,105),complex)
    for axis in range(3):
        difference = 1-np.exp(1j*qtheta[axis])
        gauge[60+15*axis:75+15*axis] = difference*np.eye(15)
        align_vertex[60*axis:60*(axis+1),:60] = difference*np.eye(60)
        align_vertex[60*axis:60*(axis+1),60+15*axis:75+15*axis] = -orbit_columns
    curl = np.zeros((45,105),complex)
    for face,(i,j) in enumerate(((0,1),(0,2),(1,2))):
        curl[face*15:(face+1)*15,60+i*15:75+i*15] = (1-np.exp(1j*qtheta[j]))*np.eye(15)
        curl[face*15:(face+1)*15,60+j*15:75+j*15] = (np.exp(1j*qtheta[i])-1)*np.eye(15)
    alignment = cfg.alignment*(align_vertex.conj().T@align_vertex)
    colour = .7*cfg.Lambda**1.25/2*(curl.conj().T@curl)
    bosonic = alignment+colour
    bosonic[:60,:60] += elastic_hessian(frame,basis,cfg.stiffness,0.)
    sea = np.zeros((105,105),complex)
    contacts = np.zeros_like(sea)
    vertex_ward = []
    quantum_metric = np.zeros_like(sea)
    for load,band,x,role in data['parts']:
        h = np.einsum('pm,mij->pij',x,frame)
        values,vectors = np.linalg.eigh(h)
        sign = -1 if role.startswith('neutral') else 1
        occupied = slice(2,4) if sign < 0 else slice(0,2)
        empty = slice(0,2) if sign < 0 else slice(2,4)
        occupied_vectors = vectors[:,:,occupied]
        projector = occupied_vectors@occupied_vectors.conj().transpose(0,2,1)
        vertices = np.zeros((105,volume,4,4),complex)
        vertices[:60] = np.einsum('pm,aij->mapij',(x+x[target])/2,basis).reshape(60,volume,4,4)
        contact = np.zeros_like(sea)
        _,paths = scalar_paths(band)
        for displacement,scalars in paths:
            axis = int(np.flatnonzero(displacement)[0]); length = int(displacement[axis])
            F = np.einsum('m,mij->ij',scalars,frame)
            insertion = sum(np.exp(1j*qtheta[axis]*j) for j in range(length))
            phase = np.exp(1j*theta@displacement)
            reverse_phase = np.exp(-1j*(theta+qtheta)@displacement)
            ft = (F@generators+generators@F)/2
            fdt = (F.conj().T@generators+generators@F.conj().T)/2
            vertices[60+15*axis:75+15*axis] += insertion*1j*(
                phase[None,:,None,None]*ft[:,None]-reverse_phase[None,:,None,None]*fdt[:,None])
            rho_forward = np.einsum('p,pij->ij',phase,projector)/volume
            rho_reverse = np.einsum('p,pij->ij',phase.conj(),projector)/volume
            ab = generators[:,None]@generators[None,:]
            ba = generators[None,:]@generators[:,None]
            mf = -.5*length*(ab+ba)
            mr = mf.copy()
            for j in range(length):
                for k in range(j+1,length):
                    z = np.exp(1j*qtheta[axis]*(k-j))
                    mf -= ab*z+ba*z.conjugate()
                    mr -= ba*z+ab*z.conjugate()
            forward = (F@mf+mf@F)/2
            reverse = (mr@F.conj().T+F.conj().T@mr)/2
            sl = slice(60+15*axis,75+15*axis)
            contact[sl,sl] += np.einsum('ij,abji->ab',rho_forward,forward)+np.einsum('ij,abji->ab',rho_reverse,reverse)
            delta_f = (scalars[:,None,None,None]*basis[None]).reshape(60,4,4)
            z = np.exp(-1j*qtheta@displacement)
            mixed_forward = .5j*insertion*(delta_f[:,None]@generators[None]+z*(generators[None]@delta_f[:,None]))
            delta_fd = (scalars.conj()[:,None,None,None]*basis[None]).reshape(60,4,4)
            mixed_reverse = -.5j*insertion*(generators[None]@delta_fd[:,None]+z*(delta_fd[:,None]@generators[None]))
            mixed = np.einsum('ij,abji->ab',rho_forward,mixed_forward)+np.einsum('ij,abji->ab',rho_reverse,mixed_reverse)
            contact[:60,sl] += mixed
            contact[sl,:60] += mixed.conj().T
        bubble = np.zeros_like(sea)
        metric = np.zeros_like(sea)
        for target_sector,source_sector in ((empty,occupied),(occupied,empty)):
            tv = vectors[target,:,target_sector]; sv = vectors[:,:,source_sector]
            features = np.einsum('pie,apij,pjo->apeo',tv.conj(),vertices,sv)
            denominator = np.abs(values[target,target_sector][:,:,None]-values[:,source_sector][:,None,:])
            weighted = (features/np.sqrt(denominator)[None]).reshape(105,-1)
            bubble -= weighted.conj()@weighted.T/volume
            metric_features = (features/denominator[None]).reshape(105,-1)
            metric += .5*(metric_features.conj()@metric_features.T)/volume
        sea += load*(bubble+sign*contact)
        contacts += load*sign*contact
        quantum_metric += (1 if sign < 0 else load)*metric
        actual = np.einsum('apij,at->tpij',vertices,gauge)
        expected = np.asarray([1j*(t@h-h[target]@t) for t in generators])
        vertex_ward.append(dict(role=role,relative=float(np.linalg.norm(actual-expected)/(1+np.linalg.norm(expected))),
                                absolute=float(np.max(np.abs(actual-expected)))))
    full = (bosonic+sea+bosonic.conj().T+sea.conj().T)/2
    normal = null_space(gauge.conj().T)
    physical = normal.conj().T@full@normal
    kinetic = normal.conj().T@np.diag([cfg.chi]*60+[.6*cfg.chi]*45)@normal
    kv,ku = np.linalg.eigh(kinetic)
    kr = (ku*np.sqrt(kv))@ku.conj().T
    frequencies2 = np.linalg.eigvalsh(kr@physical@kr)
    return dict(q=q.tolist(),full=full,sea=sea,bosonic=bosonic,normal=normal,
        principal_cometric=kinetic,physical=physical,frequencies_squared=frequencies2,
        gauge=gauge,alignment_unit=align_vertex.conj().T@align_vertex,
        colour_unit=curl.conj().T@curl,quantum_metric=quantum_metric,
        vertex_Ward=vertex_ward,gauge_Hessian_residual=float(np.linalg.norm(full@gauge)),
        omitted_contact_gauge_defect=float(np.linalg.norm((full-contacts)@gauge)),
        orbit_Gram=orbit_columns.T@orbit_columns)

def high_precision_heavy_mean(band: RotationBand, size: int, seed: np.ndarray) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Refine the SAME weighted Gram equations using actual scalar-path bytes.

    A binary64 stationary estimate cannot centre a 1e-93 packet in a 1e245
    potential. Decimal coordinates, not a falsely exact float, define this state.
    """
    with mp.workdps(220):
        rows = mp_uniform_coefficients(band,size)
        squares = [(r[0]**2,sum(z*z for z in r[1:])) for r in rows]
        kappa = 2/mp.mpf(band.a)
        g0,gs = mp.mpf(float(seed[0,0])),mp.mpf(float(seed[1,1]))
        for _ in range(12):
            radii = [mp.sqrt(g0*m2+gs*k2) for m2,k2 in squares]
            f0 = kappa*g0-sum(m2/r for (m2,_),r in zip(squares,radii))/len(rows)
            fs = 3*kappa*gs-sum(k2/r for (_,k2),r in zip(squares,radii))/len(rows)
            if max(abs(f0),abs(fs)) < mp.mpf('1e-200'):
                break
            h00 = kappa+sum(m2*m2/(2*r**3) for (m2,_),r in zip(squares,radii))/len(rows)
            hss = 3*kappa+sum(k2*k2/(2*r**3) for (_,k2),r in zip(squares,radii))/len(rows)
            cross = sum(m2*k2/(2*r**3) for (m2,k2),r in zip(squares,radii))/len(rows)
            step = mp.lu_solve(mp.matrix([[h00,cross],[cross,hss]]),mp.matrix([f0,fs]))
            g0 -= step[0]; gs -= step[1]
        residual = max(abs(f0),abs(fs))
        if residual >= mp.mpf('1e-200'):
            raise ArithmeticError('High precision actual-coupling mean did not converge')
        encoded = np.diag([float(g0),float(gs),float(gs),float(gs)])
        frame_error = max(abs(mp.mpf(float(np.sqrt(encoded[i,i])))-mp.sqrt(z))
                          for i,z in enumerate((g0,gs,gs,gs)))
        rounded_radii = [mp.sqrt(mp.mpf(float(encoded[0,0]))*m2+
                                mp.mpf(float(encoded[1,1]))*k2) for m2,k2 in squares]
        rounded_f0 = kappa*mp.mpf(float(encoded[0,0]))-sum(
            m2/r for (m2,_),r in zip(squares,rounded_radii))/len(rows)
        rounded_fs = 3*kappa*mp.mpf(float(encoded[1,1]))-sum(
            k2/r for (_,k2),r in zip(squares,rounded_radii))/len(rows)
        rounded_force = 2*mp.sqrt(g0*rounded_f0**2+gs*rounded_fs**2/3)
        return dict(G=encoded.tolist(),g0_decimal=mp.nstr(g0,220),gs_decimal=mp.nstr(gs,220),
            frame_scales_decimal=[mp.nstr(mp.sqrt(z),220) for z in (g0,gs,gs,gs)],
            normalized_gradient_decimal=mp.nstr(residual,220),
            stationary_Gram_error_upper=float(2*residual/kappa),
            float_consumer_frame_operator_error=float(frame_error),
            rounded_centre_normalized_force=float(rounded_force),
            precision=220,actual_coefficient_source='scalar_paths(RotationBand), exact binary64 coefficient values continued to 220 decimal places; exact periodic phases')

def leading_fast_frequencies(g0: float, gs: float, q: np.ndarray, size: int):

    for b0,bs,multiplicity in orbit_categories():

def joint_ground_covariance(block) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Actual normal Gaussian covariance in the full principal cometric."""
    kinetic = block['principal_cometric']
    physical = block['physical']
    kv,ku = np.linalg.eigh(kinetic)
    kr = (ku*np.sqrt(kv))@ku.conj().T
    kir = (ku/np.sqrt(kv))@ku.conj().T
    ov,ou = np.linalg.eigh(kr@physical@kr)
    if min(ov) <= 0:
        raise ArithmeticError('No normalized joint Gaussian at an unstable actual physical Hessian')
    root = (ou*np.sqrt(ov))@ou.conj().T
    inverse_root = (ou/np.sqrt(ov))@ou.conj().T
    position = .5*kr@inverse_root@kr
    momentum = .5*kir@root@kir
    full_position = block['normal']@position@block['normal'].conj().T
    energy = .5*float(np.sqrt(ov).sum())
    variance = (.5*np.trace(physical@position@physical@position)+
                .5*np.trace(kinetic@momentum@kinetic@momentum)-.25*np.trace(physical@kinetic)).real
    # Dropping colour/Coulomb kinetic structure is a physically wrong Gaussian,
    # not merely a differently labelled copy of the same state.
    wrong_kinetic = np.max(kv)*np.eye(len(kv))
    wo,wu = np.linalg.eigh(np.max(kv)*physical)
    wr = (wu*np.sqrt(wo))@wu.conj().T
    wir = (wu/np.sqrt(wo))@wu.conj().T
    wrong_position = .5*np.max(kv)*wir
    wrong_momentum = .5*wr/np.max(kv)
    wrong_variance = (.5*np.trace(physical@wrong_position@physical@wrong_position)+
        .5*np.trace(kinetic@wrong_momentum@kinetic@wrong_momentum)-.25*np.trace(physical@kinetic)).real
    return dict(position=position,momentum=momentum,full_position=full_position,
        energy=energy,variance_signed_roundoff=float(variance),
        normalized_quadratic_variance=abs(float(variance))/(1+energy**2),
        wrong_cometric_centered_variance=float(wrong_variance),
        Phi_coordinate_variance=float(np.trace(full_position[:60,:60]).real),
        colour_link_variance=float(np.trace(full_position[60:,60:]).real))


def natural_gauss_chart(block) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Canonical 45 Cartesian-normal +45 link coordinates, not a flat metric.

    Gauge-invariant link fluctuation is theta-d R^-1 O^*deltaPhi.
    Transforming BOTH the normal covariance and cometric is essential.
    """
    orbit = block['gauge'][:60]
    difference = block['gauge'][60:]
    normal = null_space(orbit.conj().T)
    inverse = np.linalg.inv(block['orbit_Gram'])
    chart = np.zeros((90,105),complex)
    chart[:45,:60] = normal.conj().T
    chart[45:,:60] = -difference@inverse@orbit.conj().T
    chart[45:,60:] = np.eye(45)
    transform = chart@block['normal']
    kinetic = transform@block['principal_cometric']@transform.conj().T
    chi = float(np.trace(block['principal_cometric']).real/
        np.trace(block['normal'].conj().T@np.diag([1.]*60+[.6]*45)@block['normal']).real)

    expected[:45,:45] = chi*np.eye(45)

    if np.linalg.norm(kinetic-expected) > 1e-10*(1+np.linalg.norm(expected)):
        raise ArithmeticError('Actual canonical Gauss cometric disagrees with native quotient')
    return dict(chart=chart,normal=normal,transform=transform,kinetic=kinetic,
        gauge_annihilation=float(np.linalg.norm(chart@block['gauge'])),
        cometric_identity_error=float(np.linalg.norm(kinetic-expected)),
        flat_colour_omission_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(expected[45:,45:]-.6*chi*np.eye(45))))


def su4_left_frame(theta: np.ndarray) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Actual left Maurer map and Haar density in exponential link coordinates."""
    from scipy.linalg import expm, expm_frechet
    generators = matrix_unit_basis()/np.sqrt(8)
    X = np.einsum('a,aij->ij',theta,generators)
    U = expm(1j*X)
    commutators = 1j*(X@generators-generators@X)
    adjoint = 2*np.einsum('aij,bji->ab',generators,commutators).real
    augmented = np.zeros((30,30))
    augmented[:15,:15] = adjoint
    augmented[:15,15:] = np.eye(15)
    J = expm(augmented)[:15,15:]
    actual = np.empty((15,15))
    for b,t in enumerate(generators):
        derivative = np.asarray(expm_frechet(1j*X,1j*t,compute_expm=False),dtype=np.complex128)
        actual[:,b] = 2*np.einsum('aij,ji->a',generators,-1j*derivative@U.conj().T).real
    error = float(np.linalg.norm(J-actual))
    if error>1e-12:
        raise ArithmeticError('Literal matrix exponential disagrees with actual Maurer connection')
    determinant = float(np.linalg.det(J))
    if determinant<=0:
        raise ArithmeticError('SU4 exponential chart has no positive Haar density')
    return dict(U=U,J_left=J,left_electric_from_canonical=np.linalg.inv(J.T),
        Haar_density=determinant,Frechet_control_error=error,
        nonidentity_frame_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(J-np.eye(15))))

def local_gauss_kinetic(frame, fields, links, normal_momenta, link_electric, matter_charge, chi) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Exact principal quadratic form in a fixed local normal slice.

    matter_charge is rho in O(Phi)^*pPhi+div_U E=rho, with E the LEFT
    electric generators. Incoming fields transport by U^* E U. Haar/ordering
    and Berry terms are not hidden in this principal-form routine.
    """
    basis = matrix_unit_basis()
    generators = basis/np.sqrt(8)
    def orbit(phi):
        matrices = 1j*(generators[:,None]@phi[None]-phi[None]@generators[:,None])
        return np.einsum('tmij,aji->mat',matrices,basis).real.reshape(60,15)/4
    o0 = orbit(frame)
    normal = null_space(o0.T)
    shape = fields.shape[:3]
    if fields.shape != (*shape,4,4,4) or links.shape != (*shape,3,4,4):
        raise ValueError('Fields must be Phi[x,y,z,mu,4,4] and links U[x,y,z,axis,4,4]')
    if normal_momenta.shape != (*shape,45) or link_electric.shape != (*shape,3,15):
        raise ValueError('Actual 45 normal and 3*15 left-electric momenta are required')
    if matter_charge.shape != (*shape,15):
        raise ValueError('Every site requires an explicit matter-charge vector')
    angular_norm = 0.
    minimum_slice = float('inf')
    for site in np.ndindex(shape):
        current = orbit(fields[site])
        a = o0.T@current
        minimum_slice = min(minimum_slice,float(np.linalg.svd(a,compute_uv=False)[-1]))
        divergence = np.sum(link_electric[site],axis=0).astype(complex)
        for axis in range(3):
            incoming = list(site); incoming[axis] = (incoming[axis]-1)%shape[axis]
            incoming_site = tuple(incoming)
            u = links[incoming_site+(axis,)]
            e = np.einsum('a,aij->ij',link_electric[incoming_site+(axis,)],generators)
            transported = u.conj().T@e@u
            divergence -= 2*np.einsum('aij,ji->a',generators,transported)
        rhs = matter_charge[site]-divergence-current.T@normal@normal_momenta[site]
        angular = o0@np.linalg.solve(a.T,rhs)
        angular_norm += float(np.vdot(angular,angular).real)
    normal_norm = float(np.vdot(normal_momenta,normal_momenta).real)
    electric_norm = float(np.vdot(link_electric,link_electric).real)
    return dict(kinetic=.5*chi*(normal_norm+angular_norm+.6*electric_norm),
        angular_Gauss_kinetic=.5*chi*angular_norm,
        frozen_angular_wrong_kinetic=.5*chi*(normal_norm+.6*electric_norm),
        slice_minimum_singular_value=minimum_slice)

def clifford_cartesian_basis():
    """Exact signed Pauli monomials, an orthogonal change of existing basis."""
    from itertools import combinations
    result = []
    for degree in range(1,5):
        for indices in combinations(range(4),degree):
            value = np.eye(4,dtype=complex)
            for index in indices:
                value = value@SELECTED[index]
            result.append((1j**(degree*(degree-1)//2))*value)
    basis = np.asarray(result)
    error = np.max(np.abs(np.einsum('aij,bji->ab',basis,basis)-4*np.eye(15)))
    if error != 0:
        raise ArithmeticError('Selected Clifford monomials are not exact Cartesian units')
    return basis

def noncompact_EM_Gauss_control(size: int) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Execute the real-gradient Gauss solution on the actual periodic box."""
    sites = periodic_grid(size)
    volume = len(sites)
    index = {tuple(site):i for i,site in enumerate(sites)}
    divergence = np.zeros((volume,3*volume))
    for i,site in enumerate(sites):
        for axis in range(3):
            target = site.copy()
            target[axis] = (target[axis]+1)%size
            divergence[i,3*i+axis] = 1
            divergence[index[tuple(target)],3*i+axis] = -1
    laplacian = divergence@divergence.T
    values,vectors = np.linalg.eigh(laplacian)
    expected_gap = 4*np.sin(np.pi/size)**2
    positive = values>expected_gap/2
    if int(np.count_nonzero(positive))!=volume-1:
        raise ArithmeticError('Real Gauss Laplacian has the wrong physical rank')
    green = (vectors[:,positive]/values[positive])@vectors[:,positive].T
    density = divergence[:,0]
    longitudinal = divergence.T@(green@density)
    string = np.zeros(3*volume)
    string[0] = 1
    residual = float(np.linalg.norm(divergence@longitudinal-density))
    energy = float(longitudinal@longitudinal)
    coulomb = float(density@green@density)
    if residual>1e-12 or abs(energy-coulomb)>1e-12:
        raise ArithmeticError('Actual real Gauss solution does not match Coulomb quadratic form')
    if float(np.linalg.norm(longitudinal-string))<.1:
        raise ArithmeticError('Real-gradient branch was incorrectly replaced by integer electric strings')
    return dict(Hilbert='L2(R^(2V+1)) after quotienting additive real site gauge transformations; theta_link in R^(3V), not compact U1 Haar',
        longitudinal_solution='Pi_long=D^T(DD^T)^+ rho, sum rho=0; electric Coulomb UEphys/a rho^T(DD^T)^+rho',
        coexact_plus_harmonic_dimension=3*volume-int(np.count_nonzero(positive)),
        actual_positive_Laplacian_gap=float(values[positive][0]),
        analytic_gap=float(expected_gap),Gauss_residual=residual,
        real_longitudinal_energy=energy,Coulomb_quadratic_form=coulomb,
        integer_string_energy=float(string@string),
        real_vs_integer_string_distance=float(np.linalg.norm(longitudinal-string)),
        domain='H2 compact-support product on real orthonormal coordinates; no periodization or projected integer-period lattice is asserted')

def periodic_grid(size):

def scalar_paths(band):
    """Extract, rather than duplicate, RotationBand's directed scalar paths."""
    onsite, paths = band.couplings()
    onsite_scalar = float(np.trace(onsite @ SELECTED[0]).real / 4)
    result = []
    for displacement, matrix in paths:

        if np.linalg.norm(matrix - np.einsum('m,mij->ij', scalars, SELECTED)) > 1e-12:
            raise ValueError('Scalar path is outside the four primitive orbital labels')

    return onsite_scalar, result


def local_hamiltonian(fields, band, sites, size):
    """Endpoints only, including two-step paths; add every oriented path and adjoint."""
    onsite, paths = scalar_paths(band)

    index = {tuple(site): number for number, site in enumerate(sites)}
    result = np.zeros((4 * count, 4 * count), dtype=complex)

def alignment_laplacian(sites, size):
    """One positive-axis nearest bond per site/axis, with periodic multiplicity."""
    index = {tuple(site): number for number, site in enumerate(sites)}

    for x, site in enumerate(sites):
        for axis in np.eye(3, dtype=int):
            y = index[tuple((site + axis) % size)]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local four-orbital band, without imported gamma matrices or spin labels.

The internal matrix units are bosonic qudit transitions. Spectral isotropy and
minimal block dimension SELECT their hopping pattern; they are not a dynamical
prediction of generic bosons. Many-body fermionic filling needs the statistics
supplier. Run directly for deterministic discriminating numerical evidence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import itertools
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm

I2 = np.eye(2, dtype=complex)
I4 = np.eye(4, dtype=complex)
E00, E01 = np.outer(I2[:, 0], I2[:, 0]), np.outer(I2[:, 0], I2[:, 1])
E10, E11 = E01.T, np.outer(I2[:, 1], I2[:, 1])
# Matrix units on two initially unassigned internal labels, NOT spatial spin.
TRANSITIONS = np.array([E01 + E10, -1j * (E01 - E10), E00 - E11])
X, Y, Z = TRANSITIONS
HADAMARD = (X + Z) / np.sqrt(2)
TO_WILSON = np.kron(HADAMARD, I2)
HOPPING = np.array([np.kron(Z, operator) for operator in TRANSITIONS])
MIXING = np.kron(X, I2)
# Solve the vector-action commutators; the half-angle is an output of the algebra.
ROTATION = np.array([-0.5j * HOPPING[j] @ HOPPING[k]
                     for j, k in [(1, 2), (2, 0), (0, 1)]])
CHARGE_CONJUGATION = np.kron(Y, Y)


def norm(matrix):
    return float(np.linalg.norm(matrix))


def isotropy_defect(operators):
    """Operator identity needed for two degenerate isotropic linear bands."""
    return max(norm(operators[i] @ operators[j] + operators[j] @ operators[i]
                    - (2 * I4 if i == j else 0))
               for i in range(3) for j in range(3))


def spatial_rotation(axis, angle):
    axis = np.asarray(axis, dtype=float)
    axis = axis / np.linalg.norm(axis)
    cross = np.array([[0., -axis[2], axis[1]],
                      [axis[2], 0., -axis[0]], [-axis[1], axis[0], 0.]])
    return (np.cos(angle) * np.eye(3) + (1 - np.cos(angle)) * np.outer(axis, axis)
            + np.sin(angle) * cross)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RotationBand:
    a: float
    m: float = 1.0
    e: float = 1.0
    r: float = 1.0
    v: float = 1.0
    improved: bool = False

    @property
    def charge(self):
        return -self.e

    @property
    def alpha(self):
        return HOPPING

    @property
    def beta(self):
        return MIXING

    @property
    def generators(self):
        return ROTATION

    def couplings(self):
        """h(p)=onsite+sum(T_d exp(i p.d)+T_d^dagger exp(-i p.d))."""
        coefficient = 4.5 if self.improved else 3.
        onsite = (self.m + coefficient * self.r / self.a) * MIXING
        nearest_mass = self.r / self.a if self.improved else self.r / (2 * self.a)
        terms = []
        for i in range(3):
            displacement = np.eye(3, dtype=int)[i]
            terms.append((displacement, -1j * self.v * HOPPING[i] / (2 * self.a)
                          - nearest_mass * MIXING))
            if self.improved:
                terms.append((2 * displacement, self.r * MIXING / (4 * self.a)))
        return onsite, terms

    def h_from_couplings(self, p):
        onsite, terms = self.couplings()
        result = onsite.copy()
        for displacement, coupling in terms:
            phase = np.exp(1j * self.a * np.dot(p, displacement))
            result += coupling * phase + coupling.conj().T * phase.conjugate()
        return result

    def mass(self, p):
        delta = 2 * np.sin(self.a * np.asarray(p) / 2)**2
        return self.m + self.r / self.a * np.sum(delta**2 if self.improved else delta)

    def h(self, p):
        return (np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', self.v * np.sin(self.a * np.asarray(p)) / self.a,
                          HOPPING) + self.mass(p) * MIXING)

    def energy(self, p):
        return float(np.sqrt(np.sum((self.v * np.sin(self.a * np.asarray(p)) / self.a)**2)
                             + self.mass(p)**2))

    def continuum_h(self, p):
        return self.v * np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', p, HOPPING) + self.m * MIXING

    def projector(self, p, sign=1):
        if sign not in (-1, 1):
            raise ValueError('sector sign must be +1 or -1')
        return (I4 + sign * self.h(p) / self.energy(p)) / 2

    def rotation(self, axis, angle):
        axis = np.asarray(axis, dtype=float)
        axis = axis / np.linalg.norm(axis)
        return expm(-1j * angle * np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', axis, ROTATION))

    def spinor(self, p, label):
        """Positive-band basis; labels refer to the derived rest-frame J_z."""
        energy, mass = self.energy(p), self.mass(p)
        chi = I2[:, label]
        lower = np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', self.v * np.sin(self.a * np.asarray(p)) / self.a,
                          TRANSITIONS) @ chi
        wilson_vector = np.concatenate((np.sqrt((energy + mass) / (2 * energy)) * chi,
                                        lower / np.sqrt(2 * energy * (energy + mass))))
        return TO_WILSON.conj().T @ wilson_vector

    def current(self, pout, pin):
        """Finite-transfer midpoint-link current divided by charge."""
        midpoint = self.a * (np.asarray(pout) + np.asarray(pin)) / 2
        mass_vertex = self.r * np.sin(midpoint)
        if self.improved:
            transfer = self.a * (np.asarray(pout) - np.asarray(pin)) / 2
            mass_vertex = self.r * (2 * np.sin(midpoint)
                                    - np.cos(transfer) * np.sin(2 * midpoint))
        return (self.v * np.cos(midpoint)[:, None, None] * HOPPING
                + mass_vertex[:, None, None] * MIXING)

    def vertex(self, pout, pin, eps):
        return self.charge * (eps[0] * I4
                              - np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', eps[1:], self.current(pout, pin)))

    def contact(self, pout, pin, eps_in, eps_out, k, kout):
        midpoint = self.a * (np.asarray(pout) + np.asarray(pin)) / 2
        curvature = self.r * np.cos(midpoint)
        if self.improved:
            curvature = self.r * (2 * np.cos(midpoint)
                                  - 2 * np.cos(self.a * np.asarray(k) / 2)
                                  * np.cos(self.a * np.asarray(kout) / 2)
                                  * np.cos(2 * midpoint))
        matrices = self.a * (-self.v * np.sin(midpoint)[:, None, None] * HOPPING
                            + curvature[:, None, None] * MIXING)
        return self.e**2 * np.einsum('i,i,ijk->jk', eps_in[1:], eps_out[1:], matrices)


def local_bosonic_operators():
    """15-state local qudit: vacuum, four singles, ten bosonic doubles."""
    basis = sorted((occupation for occupation in itertools.product(range(3), repeat=4)
                    if sum(occupation) <= 2), key=lambda state: (sum(state), state))
    lookup = {state: index for index, state in enumerate(basis)}
    lowering = []
    for orbital in range(4):
        operator = np.zeros((len(basis), len(basis)), dtype=complex)
        for column, state in enumerate(basis):
            if state[orbital]:
                target = list(state)
                target[orbital] -= 1
                operator[lookup[tuple(target)], column] = np.sqrt(state[orbital])
        lowering.append(operator)
    return basis, np.array(lowering), np.diag([sum(state) for state in basis])


def bosonic_dimer_probe():
    """Actual finite-penalty two-site sector; double occupations are not hidden."""
    band = RotationBand(0.5)
    onsite, terms = band.couplings()
    hopping = terms[0][1]
    omega = 20.
    single = np.block([[onsite + omega * I4, hopping],
                       [hopping.conj().T, onsite + omega * I4]])
    # Two total bosons on eight modes; each site's local cutoff is still two.
    basis = []
    for first in range(8):
        for second in range(first, 8):
            occupation = [0] * 8
            occupation[first] += 1
            occupation[second] += 1
            basis.append(tuple(occupation))
    lookup = {state: index for index, state in enumerate(basis)}
    quadratic = np.zeros((len(basis), len(basis)), dtype=complex)
    for column, state in enumerate(basis):
        for source in range(8):
            if not state[source]:
                continue
            intermediate = list(state)
            intermediate[source] -= 1
            for target in range(8):
                output = intermediate.copy()
                output[target] += 1
                amplitude = np.sqrt(state[source] * (intermediate[target] + 1))
                quadratic[lookup[tuple(output)], column] += single[target, source] * amplitude
    doubles = np.array([sum(state[:4]) * (sum(state[:4]) - 1) / 2
                        + sum(state[4:]) * (sum(state[4:]) - 1) / 2 for state in basis])
    rows = []
    for penalty in [2., 8., 32.]:
        h = quadratic + penalty * np.diag(doubles)
        energies, states = np.linalg.eigh(h)
        state = states[:, 0]
        rows.append(dict(Delta=penalty, lowest_two_boson_energy=float(energies[0]),
                         double_occupation_probability=float(np.vdot(state, doubles * state).real),
                         actual_eigenstate_residual=norm(h @ state - energies[0] * state)))
    local_basis, lowering, number = local_bosonic_operators()
    return dict(local_dimension=len(local_basis), two_particle_dimension=len(basis),
                local_number_action_residual=max(norm(number @ b - b @ number + b)
                                                 for b in lowering),
                single_sector_energies=np.linalg.eigvalsh(single).tolist(),
                two_particle_hermiticity_residual=norm(quadratic - quadratic.conj().T),
                finite_penalty_extra_sector=rows,
                interpretation='Bare bosonic model only: finite Delta leaves measurable double-occupation admixture; not CAR.')


def magnetic_probe(m=1., v=1., q=-1.):
    """Weak-field spectrum of the derived continuum generator, not lattice g."""
    cutoff = 6
    lowering = np.diag(np.sqrt(np.arange(1, cutoff)), 1).astype(complex)
    rows = []
    for field in [0.02, 0.01, 0.005, 0.0025]:
        scale = np.sqrt(abs(q * field) / 2)
        pix = scale * (lowering + lowering.conj().T)
        piy = -1j * np.sign(q * field) * scale * (lowering - lowering.conj().T)
        h = (np.kron(m * MIXING, np.eye(cutoff))
             + v * np.kron(HOPPING[0], pix) + v * np.kron(HOPPING[1], piy))
        rest_positive = np.array([1., 1.]) / np.sqrt(2)
        energies, variances, spectral_distances = [], [], []
        spectrum = np.linalg.eigvalsh(h)
        for label in [0, 1]:
            state = np.kron(np.kron(rest_positive, I2[:, label]), np.eye(cutoff)[:, 0])
            squared_state = h @ (h @ state)
            squared_energy = float(np.vdot(state, squared_state).real)
            energy = np.sqrt(squared_energy)
            energies.append(float(energy))
            variances.append(norm(squared_state - squared_energy * state))
            spectral_distances.append(float(np.min(abs(spectrum - energy))))
        split = abs(energies[0] - energies[1])
        rows.append(dict(B=field, positive_energies=energies,
                         g_from_weak_field_split=float(2 * m * split / (v*v * abs(q*field))),
                         squared_eigenstate_residual=max(variances),
                         actual_spectrum_distance=max(spectral_distances)))
    return rows


def run():

            rows.append(dict(a=a, improved=improved,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Half-filled sea selects a Clifford four-frame from an HS budget, not a penalty.

The proof is in sea_selection.md. This CLI computes actual occupied eigenvalues
for unrestricted traceless Hermitian orthonormal frames and the existing local
RotationBand couplings. No Dirac spectrum is assumed for the alternatives.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import itertools
import json
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm

from rotation_band import HOPPING, I4, MIXING, RotationBand, spatial_rotation

SELECTED = np.concatenate((MIXING[None], HOPPING))
QUADRATIC_PAIRS = list(itertools.combinations_with_replacement(range(4), 2))


def matrix_unit_basis():
    """All 15 traceless Hermitian matrix-unit directions, tr(B_a B_b)=4 delta."""
    units = np.eye(4, dtype=complex)
    basis = []
    for i, j in itertools.combinations(range(4), 2):
        unit = np.outer(units[:, i], units[:, j])
        basis.extend((np.sqrt(2) * (unit + unit.conj().T),
                      -1j * np.sqrt(2) * (unit - unit.conj().T)))
    for k in range(1, 4):
        diagonal = np.zeros(4)
        diagonal[:k], diagonal[k] = 1, -k
        basis.append(np.sqrt(4 / (k * (k + 1))) * np.diag(diagonal))
    return np.array(basis)


def gram(frame):
    return np.einsum('aij,bji->ab', frame, frame).real / 4


def random_frame(rng, basis):
    coefficients, _ = np.linalg.qr(rng.normal(size=(15, 4)))
    return np.einsum('am,aij->mij', coefficients, basis)


def coefficients(band, momenta):
    return np.column_stack(([band.mass(p) for p in momenta],
                            band.v * np.sin(band.a * momenta) / band.a))


def quadratic_design(x):
    # Off-diagonal columns multiply anticommutators, diagonal ones A_mu^2-I.
    return np.column_stack([x[:, i] * x[:, j] for i, j in QUADRATIC_PAIRS])


def rank_report(x) -> dict[str, Any]:
    design = quadratic_design(x)
    singular = np.linalg.svd(design, compute_uv=False)
    tolerance = max(design.shape) * np.finfo(float).eps * singular[0]
    rank = int(np.sum(singular > tolerance))
    return dict(momentum_count=len(x), quadratic_rank=rank,
                columns=[list(pair) for pair in QUADRATIC_PAIRS],
                singular_values=singular.tolist(),
                rank_tolerance=float(tolerance),
                saturation_forces_full_clifford=(rank == 10))


def minimal_rank_witness(band) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Ten momenta with an analytic nonzero determinant, even on the L=3 cube."""
    k = 2 * np.pi / (3 * band.a)
    axes = np.eye(3)
    momenta = np.array([np.zeros(3)]
                       + [sign * k * axes[i] for i in range(3) for sign in [1, -1]]
                       + [k * (axes[i] + axes[j]) for i, j in itertools.combinations(range(3), 2)])
    x = coefficients(band, momenta)
    measured = float(abs(np.linalg.det(quadratic_design(x))))
    mu, t = x[1, 0], x[1, 1]
    predicted = float(8 * band.m**2 * mu**3 * abs(t)**15)
    return dict(**rank_report(x), momenta=momenta.tolist(),
                determinant_absolute=measured, analytic_determinant_absolute=predicted,
                determinant_relative_error=abs(measured / predicted - 1))


def reframe(matrix, frame):
    """Keep RotationBand's exact local scalar couplings, vary only orbital frame."""
    weights = np.einsum('aij,ji->a', SELECTED, matrix) / 4
    return np.einsum('a,aij->ij', weights, frame)


def h_from_couplings(band, momenta, frame):
    onsite, terms = band.couplings()
    h = np.broadcast_to(reframe(onsite, frame), (len(momenta), 4, 4)).copy()
    for displacement, coupling in terms:
        phase = np.exp(1j * band.a * (momenta @ displacement))
        varied = reframe(coupling, frame)
        h += phase[:, None, None] * varied
        h += phase.conj()[:, None, None] * varied.conj().T
    return h


def algebra_defects(frame):
    return np.array([frame[i] @ frame[j] + frame[j] @ frame[i]
                     - (2 * I4 if i == j else 0)
                     for i, j in QUADRATIC_PAIRS])


def evaluate(frame, band, momenta) -> dict[str, Any]:
    x = coefficients(band, momenta)
    h = h_from_couplings(band, momenta, frame)
    eigenvalues = np.linalg.eigvalsh(h)
    occupied = eigenvalues[:, :2].sum(axis=1)
    q = np.einsum('pij,pji->p', h, h).real
    lower_bound = -np.sqrt(np.maximum(q, 0))
    excess = occupied - lower_bound
    pair_splitting = ((eigenvalues[:, 1] - eigenvalues[:, 0])**2
                     + (eigenvalues[:, 3] - eigenvalues[:, 2])**2) / 2
    saturation = h @ h - (q / 4)[:, None, None] * I4
    defects = algebra_defects(frame)
    return dict(sea_energy=float(occupied.sum()),
                sea_lower_bound=float(lower_bound.sum()),
                excess_energy=float(excess.sum()),
                minimum_pointwise_excess=float(excess.min()),
                maximum_pointwise_excess=float(excess.max()),
                maximum_saturation_error=float(np.max(np.linalg.norm(saturation, axis=(1, 2)))),
                maximum_clifford_defect=float(np.max(np.linalg.norm(defects, axis=(1, 2)))),
                gram_error=float(np.linalg.norm(gram(frame) - np.eye(4))),
                trace_error=float(np.max(abs(np.trace(frame, axis1=1, axis2=2)))),
                hermiticity_error=float(np.linalg.norm(frame - frame.conj().transpose(0, 2, 1))),
                local_coupling_error=float(np.max(np.linalg.norm(
                    h - np.einsum('pa,aij->pij', x, frame), axis=(1, 2)))),
                fixed_budget_error=float(np.max(abs(q - 4 * np.sum(x**2, axis=1)))),
                exact_pair_splitting_identity_error=float(np.max(abs(q - occupied**2 - pair_splitting))),
                sample_eigenvalues=eigenvalues[:3].tolist())


def rotated_mass_frame(theta, basis):
    """An exact SO(15) plane rotation, NOT Gram restoration after perturbation."""
    # This matrix unit is orthogonal to the four selected directions. It commutes
    # with M,T3 and anticommutes with T1,T2; hence strictly positive curvature.
    b = np.diag([1., -1., 1., -1.]).astype(complex)
    u = np.einsum('aij,ji->a', basis, MIXING).real / 4
    w = np.einsum('aij,ji->a', basis, b).real / 4
    generator = np.outer(w, u) - np.outer(u, w)
    rotation = expm(theta * generator)
    coordinates = np.einsum('aij,mji->am', basis, SELECTED).real / 4
    frame = np.einsum('am,aij->mij', rotation @ coordinates, basis)
    return frame, float(np.linalg.norm(rotation.T @ rotation - np.eye(15)))


def curvature_probe(band, momenta, basis) -> dict[str, Any]:
    x = coefficients(band, momenta)
    radius = np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1)
    predicted = float(np.sum(2 * x[:, 0]**2 * (x[:, 0]**2 + x[:, 3]**2) / radius**3))
    selected_energy = evaluate(SELECTED, band, momenta)['sea_energy']
    rows = []
    for theta in [0.1, 0.03, 0.01, 0.003]:
        plus, orthogonality = rotated_mass_frame(theta, basis)
        minus, _ = rotated_mass_frame(-theta, basis)
        plus_result, minus_result = evaluate(plus, band, momenta), evaluate(minus, band, momenta)
        measured = (plus_result['sea_energy'] + minus_result['sea_energy']
                    - 2 * selected_energy) / theta**2
        rows.append(dict(theta=theta, excess_energy=plus_result['excess_energy'],
                         gram_error=plus_result['gram_error'],
                         so15_orthogonality_error=orthogonality,
                         clifford_defect=plus_result['maximum_clifford_defect'],
                         measured_second_derivative=float(measured),
                         relative_curvature_error=float(abs(measured / predicted - 1))))
    return dict(analytic_second_derivative=predicted, path=rows)


def selected_consumer_probe(band, momenta) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Use unchanged RotationBand spinors, link current and SU(2) rotations."""
    p = np.array([0.23, -0.17, 0.31]) / band.a
    pout = np.array([-0.11, 0.28, 0.19]) / band.a
    axis, angle = np.array([1., -2., 3.]), 0.47
    j = band.generators
    commutator = max(np.linalg.norm(j[i] @ j[k] - j[k] @ j[i]
                                    - 1j * j[l])
                     for i, k, l in [(0, 1, 2), (1, 2, 0), (2, 0, 1)])
    rotation = band.rotation(axis, angle)
    spatial = spatial_rotation(axis, angle)
    vector_residual = max(np.linalg.norm(rotation @ band.alpha[i] @ rotation.conj().T
                                        - np.einsum('j,jab->ab', spatial[:, i], band.alpha))
                          for i in range(3))
    sine_transfer = 2 * np.sin(band.a * (pout - p) / 2) / band.a
    ward = band.h(pout) - band.h(p) - np.einsum('i,ijk->jk', sine_transfer, band.current(pout, p))
    return dict(coupling_to_existing_h_error=max(float(np.linalg.norm(
                    h - band.h(p0))) for p0, h in zip(momenta, h_from_couplings(band, momenta, SELECTED))),
                spinor_eigenstate_error=max(float(np.linalg.norm(
                    band.h(p) @ band.spinor(p, label) - band.energy(p) * band.spinor(p, label)))
                    for label in range(2)),
                su2_commutator_error=float(commutator),
                casimir_error=float(np.linalg.norm(np.sum(j @ j, axis=0) - 0.75 * I4)),
                full_turn_minus_identity_error=float(np.linalg.norm(band.rotation(axis, 2 * np.pi) + I4)),
                vector_rotation_error=float(vector_residual),
                finite_link_current_ward_error=float(np.linalg.norm(ward)),
                rest_generator_spectrum=np.linalg.eigvalsh(j[2]).tolist())


def run(args):
    band = RotationBand(a=args.a, m=args.m, r=args.r, v=args.v, improved=args.improved)
    basis = matrix_unit_basis()
    rng = np.random.default_rng(args.seed)
    n = args.lattice_size
    momenta = np.array(list(itertools.product(range(n), repeat=3))) * (2 * np.pi / (n * band.a))
    # Independent noncyclic input guards against silently treating rank-poor
    # cubic grids (notably L=2) as full identifiability of ten quadratic products.
    rich = rng.uniform(-np.pi / band.a, np.pi / band.a, (48, 3))
    diagonal = np.column_stack([np.linspace(-2, 2, 13) / band.a] * 3)
    selected = evaluate(SELECTED, band, momenta)
    alternatives = [evaluate(random_frame(rng, basis), band, momenta)
                    for _ in range(args.alternatives)]
    rich_selected = evaluate(SELECTED, band, rich)
    curvature = curvature_probe(band, momenta, basis)
    consumer = selected_consumer_probe(band, momenta)
    rank = rank_report(coefficients(band, momenta))
    rich_rank = rank_report(coefficients(band, rich))
    witness = minimal_rank_witness(band)
    checks = dict(matrix_unit_basis_orthonormal=np.linalg.norm(gram(basis) - np.eye(15)) < 1e-12,
                  selected_attains_sea_bound=abs(selected['excess_energy']) < 1e-9,
                  alternatives_respect_budget=all(row['gram_error'] < 1e-12 and row['trace_error'] < 1e-12
                                                  and row['hermiticity_error'] < 1e-12 for row in alternatives),
                  actual_occupied_energy_obeys_bound=all(row['minimum_pointwise_excess'] > -1e-10
                                                        for row in alternatives + [selected]),
                  alternatives_have_nonzero_excess=all(row['excess_energy'] > 1e-6 for row in alternatives),
                  rich_inputs_identify_full_algebra=rich_rank['quadratic_rank'] == 10,
                  analytic_ten_point_rank_witness=witness['quadratic_rank'] == 10
                      and witness['determinant_relative_error'] < 1e-10,
                  rich_selected_attains_bound=abs(rich_selected['excess_energy']) < 1e-9,
                  coupling_and_budget_identities=all(row['local_coupling_error'] < 1e-10
                                                      and row['fixed_budget_error'] < 1e-9
                                                      and row['exact_pair_splitting_identity_error'] < 1e-9
                                                      for row in alternatives + [selected]),
                  perturbation_has_positive_curvature=curvature['analytic_second_derivative'] > 0
                      and all(row['excess_energy'] > 0 for row in curvature['path'])
                      and curvature['path'][-1]['relative_curvature_error'] < 1e-4,
                  existing_spinor_rotation_current_consumer=all(value < 1e-10 for key, value in consumer.items()
                                                                if key.endswith('error')))
    report = dict(scope='Conditional uniform-orbital mean-field energy theorem; no anticommutator penalty, no full-QED origin claim.',
                  parameters=vars(args), basis='15 Hermitian traceless matrix-unit directions',
                  cubic_momentum_identifiability=rank, noncyclic_momentum_identifiability=rich_rank,
                  adverse_diagonal_momentum_identifiability=rank_report(coefficients(band, diagonal)),
                  exact_ten_momentum_rank_witness=witness,
                  selected=selected, alternatives=alternatives, noncyclic_selected=rich_selected,
                  gram_preserving_curvature=curvature, existing_rotation_band_consumer=consumer,
                  assertions={key: bool(value) for key, value in checks.items()})
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    return 0 if all(checks.values()) else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--a', type=float, default=0.5)
    parser.add_argument('--m', type=float, default=1.)
    parser.add_argument('--r', type=float, default=1.)
    parser.add_argument('--v', type=float, default=1.)
    parser.add_argument('--improved', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--lattice-size', type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument('--alternatives', type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=22291)

    if (not all(np.isfinite([args.a, args.m, args.r, args.v]))
            or min(args.a, args.m, args.v) <= 0 or args.r < 0
            or args.lattice_size < 2 or args.alternatives < 1):
        parser.error('Require finite a,m,v>0, r>=0, lattice-size>=2 and alternatives>=1.')
    return run(args)
